BiblicalUsage: Chamiyts appears once, in the picture of a restored land: the oxen and young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean, seasoned provender, winnowed with the shovel and the fan.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even the cattle's fodder is part of God's promise: when He heals His people, the land feeds them well.
